protocol.cold: fresh browser context; HTTP cache disabled; includes navigation/API/parsing/fonts/decoded thumbnail images
protocol.warm: one discarded interaction warmup per fixture; five seeded randomized rounds; canonical source restored before each navigation
protocol.paint: trusted native event capture timestamp → stable source-ID/content/order oracle → second rAF; painted-frame upper bound, not exact compositor timestamp
protocol.nativePaintCrossCheck: Event Timing entries reported separately, >=16ms reporting threshold; missing entries are N/A, not0
protocol.profiling: Normal production only; React commit N/A; separate profiling-build data must not enter these distributions
protocol.drop: genuine held native drag across offscreen viewport; scrollIntoView target strategy, not an autoscroll claim
protocol.interpretation: DOM/heap are browser observations, not jsdom counts or memory-leak claims; layout/script/task counters and resource timings are attribution hints, not causal proof
